Plate Bibliography

← Interpreting the bird card / Plate Bibliography
4,094 plates

The illustration on a BeakBrain card is a plate from a historical bird book, cut to a single bird and cleared of its background. This is the whole list: 4,094 plates, 3,673 scanned by Wikimedia Commons and 421 by the Biodiversity Heritage Library, filed under the 387 illustrators, engravers and draughtsmen the record names.

3,941 are public domain and 45 are CC0. 97 are Creative Commons Attribution and 11 Attribution ShareAlike, where crediting the artist is a condition of the licence rather than a courtesy.

2,877 plates name their illustrator in the source record. 266 are unsigned there and are credited to the hand that illustrated the book they came from. The remaining 951 are credited to their source material instead, the book and the library that holds it, and each links back to it.

Symbols, and what the rest of a card means, are on the card key.
